# Organise

> Turn an existing audience into an organisation, or build a new club, community, campaign or movement with membership, tasks, surveys, workflows and sovereign organisation instances.

The system is categorised as an organisation operating system: a web-based system providing foundational organisational tools for new and growing groups, while each customer organisation runs on its own independent website and database. The system is currently under test, and applications for an independent system website are made via https://myorg.netlify.app.

## Who It Is For
- Creators, authors, singers, actors, commentators and others turning an audience or following into an action group, fan club, book club or course/membership hub
- Friends starting a new club, association, community group, local initiative, campaign, pressure group, volunteer organisation or movement
- Small organisations outgrowing spreadsheets, social media and disconnected messaging apps
- Larger organisations keeping existing systems for passive members while forming a specialised activist cadre or skunk works unit

## Core Capabilities
- Aims, plans and policies: Publish organisational aims, plans and policies for direct access
- Membership: Store and manage member information in a dedicated database
- Automated onboarding: Welcome task followed by an initial survey that adjusts the member's experience
- Surveys and feedback: Custom surveys with answers that can trigger automated reactions
- Tasks: Multi-step tasks for to-do lists, training courses with text and embedded video, or automated step workflows
- Automated workflows: Connect tasks, surveys and structural changes in background processes
- Organisational structure: Define relationships, teams, roles and permissions using 'appro' name-tags and visual structure views
- Recruitment tracking: Referral links tied to 'appro' tags to track recruitment sources and channels
- Internal messaging: In-system messaging, personal notes, and messages tied to tasks, surveys or groups
- Payments: Accept fees and memberships via integrated payment processors routed to the organisation's bank account
- Strict permissions: Dual-layer permission systems designed for volunteer administrators to protect private data and database access
- Context-aware help: A dynamic 'How?' button explaining the currently open module
